tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background on every screen. Warm paper, never pure white — white reads clinical.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and list rows sitting on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, progress tracks, unfilled severity slots — anything that reads as recessed.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers and the one card that must float above other cards.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark header blocks and the validation card. The colour of 11pm.

tokens.name: night-deep
tokens.usage: Splash, magic moment, paywall. The deepest ground in the system.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and sheets. Never used as a fill.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body and headline text on canvas, surface and surface-sunken. 15.4:1 light, 16.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Sub-labels, metadata, timestamps. 7.0:1 light, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: The quietest text that is still text — placeholders, disabled labels. 4.97:1 light, 5.24:1 dark. Do not go quieter.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline and standalone links on canvas or surface. Always underlined as well.

tokens.name: text-on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night and night-deep. 14:1 and 17:1.

tokens.name: text-on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night and night-deep. 7.5:1 light, 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The light she is moving toward. Primary CTA fill, progress fill, the moth's eyespots. Fill only — see ember-deep for text.

tokens.name: ember-deep
tokens.usage: The ember hue when it must carry text or a hairline on canvas. 5.45:1 light, 7.91:1 dark.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Pale amber tint. Highlight rows, the trial banner, selected-day background.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Warm terracotta. Temperature-category symptoms, severity 4, destructive confirmations. Takes text-on-night at 5.36:1.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Clay tint for category backgrounds and chip wells.

tokens.name: luna
tokens.usage: The moth's wing green. Physical-category symptoms, streaks, saved states. Fill only on light — see luna-deep.

tokens.name: luna-deep
tokens.usage: The luna hue when it must carry text or a thin mark. 4.87:1 light, 9.35:1 dark.

tokens.name: luna-soft
tokens.usage: Palest wing tint. Severity 1, calm empty states, the mascot's resting glow.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Mood-category symptoms. Warm, human, never pink-for-women. Takes text-primary at 7.25:1.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Neutral warm tint. Insight card backgrounds, secondary button fill.

tokens.name: iris
tokens.usage: Cognitive-category symptoms — brain fog, memory. Takes text-on-night at 5.29:1.

tokens.name: tide
tokens.usage: Sleep-category symptoms. Deep and still. Takes text-on-night at 5.37:1.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Cycle-category symptoms. Takes text-on-night at 6.4:1.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ember fill. 7.12:1.

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a clay fill. 5.36:1.

tokens.name: on-luna
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a luna fill. 6.67:1.

tokens.name: on-luna-soft
tokens.usage: Text on a luna-soft fill. 11.5:1 light, 10.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-blush
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blush fill. 7.25:1.

tokens.name: on-sand
tokens.usage: Text on a sand fill. 12.1:1 light, 11.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-iris
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an iris fill. 5.29:1.

tokens.name: on-tide
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tide fill. 5.37:1.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a plum fill. 6.4:1.

tokens.name: cat-temperature
tokens.usage: Hot flashes, night sweats, chills. 6 of 34 symptoms.

tokens.name: cat-mood
tokens.usage: Anxiety, irritability, low mood, rage. 6 of 34 symptoms.

tokens.name: cat-cognitive
tokens.usage: Brain fog, word-finding, memory lapses. 5 of 34 symptoms.

tokens.name: cat-sleep
tokens.usage: Insomnia, waking at 3am, unrefreshing sleep. 5 of 34 symptoms.

tokens.name: cat-physical
tokens.usage: Joint pain, palpitations, headaches, fatigue. 7 of 34 symptoms.

tokens.name: cat-cycle
tokens.usage: Irregular periods, flooding, spotting, cramping. 5 of 34 symptoms.

tokens.name: severity-1
tokens.usage: Mild. Never the only signal — pair with the filled-dot count and the word.

tokens.name: severity-2
tokens.usage: Moderate.

tokens.name: severity-3
tokens.usage: Strong.

tokens.name: severity-4
tokens.usage: Severe.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card edges, list dividers. Decorative — no contrast requirement.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that carry meaning — unselected option cards, input outlines. 4.18:1 light, 3.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: line-on-night
tokens.usage: Dividers and outlined pills on night surfaces.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with a 2px offset. Ink on light, cream on dark — always clears 3:1.

styles.name: displayXL
styles.usage: The magic moment and the paywall headline. Once per screen, never twice.

styles.name: displayLG
styles.usage: Screen titles and onboarding question headlines.

styles.name: displaySM
styles.usage: Card titles — insight cards, medication cards.
styles.sample: Why the anxiety comes out of nowhere

styles.name: statNumber
styles.usage: The validation percentage and streak counts. The number is the message.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Find Your Words sentences and validation copy. Italic Fraunces reads as a voice, not a label.

styles.name: bodyLG
styles.usage: Daily insight body. The only style tuned for 90 seconds of continuous reading.
styles.sample: Estrogen doesn't decline smoothly. It swings.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph and list text everywhere else.

styles.name: bodySM
styles.usage: Supporting copy under a heading or inside a dense card.

styles.name: labelLG
styles.usage: Option card labels and list row titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chip labels, field labels, tab bar labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section markers and question counters. The only style that is ever uppercased.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and calendars. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. space-6 (24px) is the screen gutter and the default gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight internal padding, gap between a title and its sub-label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chips in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on compact rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, default.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen gutter. Every screen, no exceptions.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline and the content it introduces.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above a primary button at the bottom of a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Major section break.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Splash and magic-moment vertical rhythm.

radius.note: Generous and soft. Nothing in Nuva has a sharp corner except the screen edge.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Severity swatches, small icon squares.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inline tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows, medication cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Option cards, insight cards. The workhorse.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, the validation card, large feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Modal sheets and the paywall plan block.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, progress tracks, avatars.

shadow.note: Soft, warm and low. A shadow means elevation, never decoration. In React Native these compile to shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowRadius plus elevation — the mapping table is in the brand book.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Resting list rows and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Pressed cards, floating action button, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the validation card as it rises.

tokens.name: shadow-ember
tokens.usage: Under an enabled primary button only. It is the one glow in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-well
tokens.usage: Progress tracks and unfilled severity slots.

opacity.note: The only three opacity values in the system. Anything else is a colour token, not a transparency.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and unavailable calendar days. Drop the shadow too.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Press feedback on text links and icon buttons that do not scale.

tokens.name: opacity-grain
tokens.usage: The paper grain overlay that sits above canvas on every screen.
